Depends on your luck with the boss loot

The {wiki:Makeshift Warrior Outfits|Makeshift Warrior Outfits} are obtained by using three rare items dropped by the bosses of Warzones 4, 5 and 6 of the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub|Gnome Deep Hub}: a blueprint for the armour, wooden planks for the shield and weapon, and a pot to use as a helmet. With the outfit you also get the achievement **Cobbled and Patched**.
Access to {wiki:Warzone 4|Warzone 4}, {wiki:Warzone 5|Warzone 5} and {wiki:Warzone 6|Warzone 6} of the Gnome Deep Hub, to fight the bosses.
loot from The Baron from Below (Warzone 4)
loot from The Duke of the Depths (Warzone 6)
loot from The Count of the Core (Warzone 5)
The three items are boss loot: you may need to kill them several times until they drop.
Each item unlocks a part of the outfit when you use it: plan → armour, planks → shield and weapon, pot → helmet.
Before you start: reach the Gnome Deep Hub

The entrance to the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub|Gnome Deep Hub} is in **Kazordoon**. There are two ways to get there:
1. **{wiki:Steamship}**: from {wiki:Cormaya} (near Edron, with {npc:Gurbasch}) or from **Farmine** (with {npc:Thorgrin}), say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes}. You arrive at the underground harbour of Kazordoon, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.
2. **On foot**: through the mountain entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the path to the Kazordoon entrance}). Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}.

In Kazordoon, go to the entrance of the Gnome Deep Hub, near the blesser in the **north** of the city (4 floors below ground level), and enter. Alternatively, if you are level 80+, use the {wiki:Gnomish Crystal Teleport System|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}: access is given by {npc:Xelvar} in Kazordoon and each trip uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp); the Kazordoon crystal is right next to the entrance.

Warzones 4, 5 and 6 are locked: you need **15 points** of tasks with each one's faction (10 if you have already defeated the bosses of Warzones 1, 2 and 3) and you must destroy a {item:Fragile Lava Funnel} in that faction's area. All of this is explained in the {wiki:Dangerous Depths Quest|Dangerous Depths Quest}.
After passing through a Warzone's teleport you have **8 hours** of access; if you leave after that, you have to destroy another funnel (and spend more points) to get back in.
Kill the boss of {wiki:Warzone 4|Warzone 4}, {creature:The Baron from Below}, until it drops a {item:Plan for a Makeshift Armour}. Warzone 4 is to the **east** of the Gnome Deep Hub.
You will face the creatures of the Gnome Deep Hub and Warzone 4.

Use the {item:Plan for a Makeshift Armour}. The message *"By using the plan you knock together a makeshift armour out of wooden planks, rusty nails and leather rags."* appears and you receive the base outfit.
Kill the boss of {wiki:Warzone 6|Warzone 6}, {creature:The Duke of the Depths}, until it drops some {item:Crude Wood Planks}. Warzone 6 is to the **northeast** of the Gnome Deep Hub.
You will face the creatures of Warzone 6.
Use the {item:Crude Wood Planks}. The message *"You use the wooden planks to knock up a makeshift shield and weapon."* appears.
Kill the boss of {wiki:Warzone 5|Warzone 5}, {creature:The Count of the Core}, until it drops a {item:Tinged Pot}. Warzone 5 is to the **south** of the Gnome Deep Hub.
You will face the creatures of Warzone 5.
Use the {item:Tinged Pot}. The message *"You use the tinged pot as a makeshift helmet."* appears.
Leaving the Warzones and the Gnome Deep Hub

After killing a boss, leave the room through the teleport (it takes you to that boss's Lava Pump room) and go back the same way from the Warzone to the Gnome Deep Hub. From the hub, leave through the entrance to **Kazordoon** ({coord:32624,31868,11}). To leave Kazordoon, take the {wiki:Steamship} from {npc:Brodrosch} ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), use the crystal teleport next to the hub entrance, or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
As long as the 8 hours of access have not run out, you can leave and re-enter the Warzone as many times as you like.
The **Cobbled and Patched** achievement was added one month after the quest and the outfits.
